name: Single-Arm Landmine Row
instructions: Wedge a barbell into a landmine base.
Hinge forward and row the free end one-handed to your hip.
The angled bar path hits the lats from a unique angle.
Lower slowly and repeat. Brace the core to resist rotation.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate barbell pull-pattern exercise for the lats. Single-Arm Landmine Row strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
